provenance.note: Input Java export and motion.json were absent. Geometry and original clips extracted from the supplied bbmodel; reversal policy added for integration.

units.angles: degrees in this document; radians in ModelPart

runtime_blend.type: single scalar absolute local X rotation; never add two clip rotations
runtime_blend.clock: client level gameTime plus partial tick, divided by 20; paused world freezes
runtime_blend.initial_tracking: snap to confirmed endpoint; subsequent toggles animate
runtime_blend.reverse: sample current angle and angular velocity; never reset to clip start
runtime_blend.brake: if moving away from new target, linearly reduce angular velocity to zero for at most 0.025s; shorten to avoid endpoint overshoot
runtime_blend.continue: cubic Hermite to target with preserved initial velocity and zero final velocity
runtime_blend.duration: nominal clip duration * max(0.2, abs(remaining angle)/100 degrees); cap to 3*abs(remaining angle)/abs(initial velocity) when moving toward target
runtime_blend.position_continuity: C1 at reversal, no overshoot; at rest Hermite equals exact source smoothstep
